about: Generated tables of docs/benchmarks.md, rendered by docs/scripts/render_benchmarks.py. 'rows', 'label' and 'source' come from bench/results/<machine>/<date>-consolidated/consolidated.json (the label as the docs print it); 'chain' is the end-to-end table of the same run's CONSOLIDATED.md. 'more' holds runs outside the consolidated benchmark (metrics, json_repair, languages, datatrove steps), each group with its own source, copied by hand from that run's results or report. Units: microseconds per document (rows; pyroid_us is one thread on CPython 3.15t, pyroid_us_8_threads a pool of 8, incumbents one process on CPython 3.13) and seconds per run (chain). Every value is a string copied from the source, never computed.

more.title: pyroid.metrics: ROUGE, BLEU and chrF
more.note: Milliseconds for the whole workload, median of the runs (1 run for the reference rows over 100k pairs); every row checked identical to the 1-process reference first. CPython 3.13, release wheel, load average 4 to 19 from other sessions. The references in 1 process and in 8 fork processes; pyroid in one process at threads=1 and threads=8. ROUGE: CNN/DailyMail lead-3 against the highlights, rouge1/2/L/Lsum (100k = the 11,490 pairs repeated). BLEU and chrF: WMT21 segments, first reference, default settings.

more.title: pyroid.json_repair
more.note: Single documents, best per call, CPython 3.12 (3.15t within ±10%); release wheel, load average 16 to 24 from other sessions. json_repair 0.64.5.

more.title: pyroid.json_repair: batches
more.note: 10,000 broken ~1.2 KB documents, free-threaded CPython 3.15t (GIL off), documents per second. The 8-thread rows are limited by the shared, loaded VM.

more.title: Languages: FineWeb-2 filters and MinHash
more.note: µs per document. 1,000 documents per language (each FineWeb-2 slice four times), median of 5 runs (datatrove: 2); every timed document gated first (same keep/drop, reason and signatures). Filters: FineWeb-2's chain (Gopher repetition, FineWeb quality, Gopher quality, with that language's settings); MinHash: FineWeb-2's signatures. datatrove x8: a warmed fork Pool(8). CPython 3.13, release wheel, load average 6 to 16. Chinese and Japanese run datatrove's Python tokenizers (python_tokenizer=True), at their speed and on the calling thread.
more.footnote: * An outlier: pyroid with 8 threads was slower than with 1 in this run, while the load rose; not to be quoted until rerun.

more.title: More datatrove steps
more.note: FineWeb dev slice, release wheel, CPython 3.13, taskset -c 0-7. datatrove's step alone, in one process and in a warmed multiprocessing.Pool(8); pyroid's native call at 1 and 8 threads. Medians of 5 for pyroid and 2 for datatrove, load average about 8 (URL filter: about 22). Where datatrove at 8 processes was not measured, the 8-thread speedup is against datatrove in one process.
more.source: the P6 datatrove-steps run, 2026-11-06 (scripts not committed)

more.title: datatrove's FineWeb pipeline with pyroid's steps swapped in
more.note: Whole runs on FineWeb dev (10,000 documents unless noted), wall seconds and user+sys CPU seconds including children (bash time), CPython 3.13, release wheel, taskset -c 0-7. The VM was heavily shared (load average 18 to 30), which inflates stock datatrove most; each ratio comes from a same-minute pair (stock, then pyroid). pyroid's runs include datatrove's executor phases, worker start-up, Parquet IO and the 125 MiB model load; pyroid clean includes interpreter start-up, IO and writing both outputs. All outputs have datatrove's per-document digest.
